findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_connector · Public sink: get_rank_history, search_tools, list_stores, send_feedback · Destructive: analyze.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_connector · Public sink: get_rank_history, search_tools, list_stores, send_feedback · Destructive: analyze

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
